text:
sree: Pushing live the Hosted APIlightweight endpoint (mobile/edge-focused) and mosaic-lite model to GA today. Docs + quickstart are published. Congrats to eng-runtime + devex! :tada:
lena: Amazing! Any breaking-client changes we should flag to partners?
sree: No billing or token semantics changed. Main change: new endpoint defaults to multiplexed websocket sessions for better battery and connection reuse. Legacy single-socket path still supported for 60 days with a deprecation warning.
max: Can you drop a perf summary? p50/p90/p99 for 64-token chat on mosaic-lite?
sree: p50=38ms, p90=120ms, p99=320ms on our mobile GPU profile with 8-bit quant. We also see ~2x less CPU on the client due to smaller streaming frames. I'll attach the benchmark table in docs.
pm-bot: Release checklist:
- Docs site updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/lightweight
- Changelog entry published
- SDKs: RN + Kotlin updated w/ new default
- Telemetry: add websocket connection metrics + multiplexing flag
- Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% (12h) -> 75% (24h) -> 100% (36h)
infra-bot: Note from SRE: we'll enable adaptive backpressure at the edge gateways during 25% bump. Expect increased 502s for <5min if clients retry aggressively. Please avoid sweeping retries in SDKs.
clare: Partner ops: I'll email top 20 partners with migration notes and offer 1:1 walkthroughs. Also include the performance comparisons vs hosted-mosaic.
lena: Is there any migration code snippet for the new websocket multiplexer?
sree: Yes, example for JS client:
```
import {LightClient} from '@redwood/mobile';
const client = new LightClient({ url: 'wss://hosted.redwood.ai/lightstream/v1' });
await client.open({ model: 'mosaic-lite-v1' });
const stream = client.request({ prompt: 'Summarize the note', max_tokens: 64 });
stream.on('delta', d => console.log(d));
stream.on('end', () => console.log('completed'));
```
max: Are we changing default buffer sizes or chunking?
sree: Smaller default chunks to reduce latency on cellular. SDKs now expose bufferSize & multiplex=true by default.
clare: Deprecation timeline?
sree: Warnings start in 2 weeks for SDKs using single-socket path, full switch enforced in 60 days. Ops will surface telemetry events for old-path usage so we can contact customers.
infra-bot: Post-rollout, SRE will run a 4h soak at 100% and monitor websocket error rates and connection churn. Pager if error rate >2% sustained for 5m.
lena: Great — I'll prepare release notes and update the hosted changelog. Thanks all, huge effort! :rocket:
